items.exampleEn: The news headline was about a big storm.
items.exampleZh: 新聞標題是關於一場大暴風雨。

items.exampleEn: Did you hear the announcement? The concert has been canceled.
items.exampleZh: 你聽到廣播了嗎？音樂會取消了。

items.exampleEn: We watched the broadcast of the concert on TV.
items.exampleZh: 我們在電視上看了那場演唱會的轉播。

items.exampleEn: In this game, you live in a virtual world.
items.exampleZh: 在這個遊戲裡，你生活在一個虛擬世界。

items.exampleEn: My old computer can't read this disk.
items.exampleZh: 我的舊電腦讀不了這張磁碟。

items.exampleEn: The airport scan showed nothing strange in my bag.
items.exampleZh: 機場的掃描在我的包包裡沒發現任何奇怪的東西。

items.exampleEn: The king proclaimed a holiday for the whole country.
The website is updated every morning.
items.exampleZh: 這個網站每天早上更新。

items.sentenceEn: The radio broadcast starts at seven.

items.audioEn: Please update your phone tonight, because the old software will stop working tomorrow.
items.audioZh: 請今晚更新你的手機，因為舊軟體明天就不能用了。
items.questionZh: 為什麼今晚要更新手機？
options: The old software will stop working.

items.sentenceEn: I keep all my old photos on a disk.
items.sentenceZh: 我把所有舊照片都存在一張磁碟裡。

items.sentenceEn: Attention, please. Here is an important announcement.
items.sentenceZh: 請注意，以下是一則重要公告。

items.stemEn: I only read the ____, not the whole article.
items.stemZh: 我只看了標題，沒看整篇文章。

items.stemEn: With these special glasses, you can visit a ____ museum without leaving home.
items.stemZh: 戴上這副特殊眼鏡，你不用出門就能參觀虛擬博物館。

items.passageEn: Our class visited a local radio station. In the news room, a woman was writing the headlines for the evening broadcast. She told us that she updates the news every hour. Then the manager made an announcement: the station will start a virtual tour on its website. In an old store room, we saw piles of disks with recordings from fifty years ago. A worker was making a scan of an old poster that proclaimed the opening of the station.
items.passageZh: 我們班參觀了一家地方廣播電台。在新聞室裡，一位女士正在為晚間廣播撰寫新聞標題。她告訴我們，她每個小時更新一次新聞。接著經理宣布了一件事：電台將在網站上推出虛擬導覽。在一間舊倉庫裡，我們看到一疊疊磁碟，裡面是五十年前的錄音。一位員工正在掃描一張舊海報，那張海報宣告了電台開播。

questions.questionZh: 那張舊海報宣告了什麼？

items.promptZh: 他宣稱自己是全世界最好的廚師。
referenceEn: He proclaimed himself the best cook in the world.
He proclaimed that he was the best cook in the world.
rubricZh: proclaim 表示「宣告、聲稱」，例如 proclaim that… 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）

items.instructionZh: 用 virtual 造一個句子，說說你參加過的線上活動或用過的虛擬工具。
referenceEn: I took a virtual cooking class last month.
I sometimes meet my friends in a virtual game.
rubricZh: virtual 表示「虛擬的、線上的」，例如 a virtual class 等說法
說的是自己的經驗（例如 I）
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）
